title: Shadow Cell Validation 001 — Copy-on-Write Functional Isolation
scientific_question: Does isolating new learning in an exact-clone Shadow branch produce a retention-plasticity Pareto frontier that matched direct-write/interpolation controls cannot reach, when a mature Parent is deliberately forced to serve both old and new rules?

world.name: overlapping-rule-byte-world-v1
world.answer_token: single ASCII digit predicted after the fixed prefix
world.train_objective: causal next-token cross entropy on the answer byte only

model.reason_cellular_last: Shadow expression at the answer-prediction position cannot propagate through later attention; the gate is causal and local to the measured prediction.

conflict_registration.parent_selection: highest A-eval Top-1 usage after base training

shadow_definition.lineage_output: y = W_parent h + a(x) * (W_shadow - W_parent) h

gate_calibration.representation: frozen base model Cell input at the answer-prediction position
gate_calibration.purpose: oracle-ish upper bound on expression boundary

primary_conditional_point_selection: Among registered maturity values satisfying A_regression <=0.10, choose the point with highest B_gain_fraction_of_direct; tie-break toward lower maturity. If none satisfy retention, primary point is null.

matched_controls.Direct-TX: final directly-written Parent candidate with checkpoint/rollback available
matched_controls.Shadow-Conditional-Shuffled: same Shadow weights and maturity, but gate values are deterministically permuted across the combined A/B heldout set

algebraic_identity_controls.direct_candidate_equals_shadow_candidate: Both start from identical W_parent, see identical B minibatches, use identical optimizer hyperparameters/state, and are the only trainable tensor; final operators must match within tolerance.
algebraic_identity_controls.Direct-Interp_equals_Shadow-Global: For a linear Cell and W_direct=W_shadow, W_parent + m(W_shadow-W_parent) is exactly the same effective operator as direct interpolation.
algebraic_identity_controls.Shadow-Immediate_equals_Direct-TX: At global maturity 1, both execute the same final operator.

metrics.hypervolume_domain: A_regression clipped to [0,1], B gain fraction clipped to [0,1]

classification_rule: Require valid base A performance, mature Parent conflict on every seed, Direct-TX B gain >=0.50, gate AUC >=0.90, and all algebraic identity controls. Then require a primary Shadow-Conditional point on every seed with B_gain_fraction_of_direct >=0.90. If not, SHADOW_CELL_NOT_SUPPORTED. If conditional Pareto hypervolume does not improve by >=20% over Direct-Interp, ISOLATED_SHADOW_ADVANTAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED. If Shadow-Immediate itself satisfies A_regression <=0.10 and B_gain_fraction_of_direct >=0.90 on every seed, or conditional hypervolume does not improve by >=20% over Shadow-Global, or correct-vs-shuffled A-regression advantage at the primary maturity is <0.10 on any seed, SHADOW_ISOLATION_SUPPORTED_MATURATION_NOT_NECESSARY. Otherwise SHADOW_CELL_CONTROLLED_MATURATION_SUPPORTED.
